verbetes.glosa_atual: (בָּעַל) relação sexual.
notas_originais: Keth. 3 a שויוה רבנן לבְעִילָתוֹ בְּעִילַת זנות the Rabbis (in this case) have declared his coition (by which he wanted to establish marriage), a mere act of prostitution (annulled his marriage). Ib. 73 a, a. e. אין אדם עושה בעילתו בעילת זנות the presumption is that nobody wants to make his intercourse with a woman one of prostitution (but wants to make her his wife thereby).—Ib. 4 a בעילת מצוה the marital duty, i.e. first coition; frequ. ב' ראשונה. Y. Macc. II, 31 d; a. fr.— Pl. בְּעִילוֹת. Sabb. 72 a; a. fr.

notas_originais: Targ. Gen. I, 24 sq.; a. fr.—Y. B. Mets. II, 8 c bot.; Lev. R. s. 27, a. e. ב' דקיקא small cattle ; v. בְּהֵמָה.—Pesik. B’shall. p. 93 a אתקן לי ב' get an animal ready for me (for travel). Snh. 105 a (in Hebr. dict., play on בְּעוֹר).

verbetes.glosa_atual: , v. בָּעָה, entrar, tomar posse) [em b. h. ser senhor, proteger;] ter relações sexuais (legais ou ilícitas), abraçar uma mulher.; , isso sugere que a mulher pode ser adquirida como esposa por meio de relações sexuais, v. בִּיאָה.; ela teve relações sexuais.
definicoes_originais: , v. בָּעָה, to enter into, take possession) [in b. h. to be master, protect;] to have sexual intercourse (both legal or illicit), to embrace a woman.
, this intimates that woman can be acquired as wife by intercourse, v. בִּיאָה.
notas_originais: Kidd. 9 b וּבְעָלָהּ מלמד וכ' ‘and he embraced her’ (Deut. XXIV,

—בּוֹעֵל lover, adulterer, contrad. to בַּעַל husband. Sot. V, 1, a. fr. כשם שאסורה לַבַּעַל … לַבּוֹעֵל as well as the woman suspected of adultery is forbidden to her husband (who must separate himself from her), so is she forbidden to the lover (who cannot marry her after leaving her husband). Yeb. 103 a שבע בעילות ב' וכ' that wicked man had seven sexual connections &c.; a. fr.—Part. pass. f. בְּעוּלָה one no longer a virgin, opp. to בתולה; married woman, opp. to ארוסה, v. אָרַס. Keth. 10 b; a. fr.— Pl. בְּעוּלוֹת. Y. Kidd. I, 58 b bot.; a. fr.

Keth. 5 a נישאת … ונִבְעֶלֶת וכ' is married on the fourth day and embraced in the night of the fifth day of the week. Ib. 3 b תִּיבָּעֵל לטפסר וכ' must first be surrendered to the (Roman) officer (jus primæ noctis); a. fr.—Masc. נִבְעַל (of the hermaphrodite). Tosef. Bicc. II, 5; Y. Yeb. VIII, 9 d bot.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , papel. passar.
notas_originais: Targ. O. Deut. XXI, 13; a. fr.—Keth. 6 b דבעי למִיבְעַל because he is anxious to perform his marital duty. Ib. דטריד דלא בעיל he is excited because he has not &c.; a. fr.
f. מְבַעֲלָא married, having had intercourse. Targ. Ruth I, 12; a. e.
as preced. Nif. Yoma 19 b ואִבְּעוּל כמה וכ', (Ms. M. ואיבעיל) and how many virgins have been seduced (to-day) in Nahardea!

verbetes.glosa_atual: precedido.); marido.; o ídolo Baal.; [o frutificador,] chuva (v. Taan. 6 b; cmp. Is. LV, 10).
definicoes_originais: [ the fructifier,] rain (v. Taan. 6 b; cmp. Is. LV, 10).
(mostly in compounds) owner of, master of, possessed of, given to &c.; e.g. ב' אבידה owner of a lost object; ב' אגדה master of Agadah, lecturer; ב' דין opponent in court; v. infra.
notas_originais: Kidd. I, 1 and she becomes her own master בגט ובמיתת הב' through a letter of divorce or on the husband’s death; a. v. fr.
Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43 a bot. ב' ראש גוייה הוה וכ' the Baal was the phallus and had the shape of a bean [read וכאפון].

בֵּית בַּ' a field sufficiently watered by rain and requiring no artificial irrigation. Tosef. M. Kat. I, 1 שדה (בית) הב'. B. Bath. III, 1. Tosef. Succ. II, 7 ערבה של ב' (sub. בית) a willow in a naturally watered field. Ib. Shebi. II, 4 בשל ב' (= בשדה של ב'), opp. של שוקי. Num. R. s. 16 the Egyptian gods של שקר הם (read שקי) are gods of artificial drainage, but those of Canaan של ב' הם are gods of rain; (Tanḥ. Sh’laḥ 13, through misunderstanding, שקר … בעליכח.
Pes. 86 b ב' השם אני I am so named.— Pl. בְּעָלִים, בְּעָלִין owners ; mostly as sing. owner. B. Mets. VIII, 1; a. fr. [Y. Dem. III, 23 b bot. לבלעין, read לבעלין.]

Snh. 19 b.—Ib. בעלי מ' those entertaining considerations (of fear), hesitating to do justice.—ב' שיבה gray-haired. Ned. III, 8.—ב' תשובה repentant sinner. Succ. 53 a; a. fr.—ב' תשובות a man of many objections or excuses. Gen. R. s. 20 beg.—[For other compounds, not self-evident, see the respective determinants.]

notas_originais: בְּעֵיל, בְּעַל ch. same.
Targ. O. Ex. XXI, 3; a. fr.—Taan. 6 b מטרא ב' וכ' the rain is the husband (fructifier) of the field; v. preced. 3).
Targ. Jud. VI, 25; a. e.— Pl. בַּעֲלַיָּא. Ib. II, 11; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (precedido.) amante, proprietário etc. General R. s. 52 (traduzindo בְּעֻלַת, Gen. XX, 3, como se fosse בּעֲלַת) מרתא דבעלה a amante de seu marido.
definicoes_originais: (preced.) mistress, owner &c. Gen. R. s. 52 (rendering בְּעֻלַת, Gen. XX, 3, as though בּעֲלַת) מרתא דבעלה her husband’s mistress.
notas_originais: —Compounds are mostly self-evident, e.g. בעלת הגט the woman receiving the letter of divorce;—ב' איברים an animal of large build. Ber. 32 a; v. בַּעַל.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. בָּעָה; cmp. בהל) ficar entusiasmado.; estar com pressa, estar ansioso.
definicoes_originais: (v. בָּעָה; cmp. בהל) to be excited.
to be in a hurry, be anxious.
notas_originais: —Af. אַבַּע to hurry. Targ. I Kings XXII, 9 א' מיכיה Ar. (ed. תבע, h. text מהרה) bring … quickly. Targ. Ezek. XXIV, 5.—Part. pass. מַבַּע, (מִבְ') מַבְּעָא quick. Targ. Deut. XXXII, 35.— Pl. מַבְּעִין. Targ. Num. XXXII, 17.
Targ. Ps. XXXI, 23 באִתַּבָּעוּתִי Ms. (ed. באִתְבָּעוּתִי). Targ. II Kings VII, 15; Targ. II Sam. IV, 4, v. בְּעֵי I.

notas_originais: Kel. XXX, 3 עשאו בין בב' if he mended it either with &c. B. Bath. 89 b (diff. fr. אבר, a. גיסטרא, cassiterum, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Plumbum). Men. 28 b; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , v. cmp. בָּאֵר) [ limpar,]; queimar (ato. a. neutro).; estar vazio.; para comer.
definicoes_originais: , v. בָּעָה; cmp. בָּאֵר) [ to clear,]
to clear, remove (out of existence or out of possession).
(b. h.) to start a fire, enkindle.
to start or entertain a fire, to clear a field.
to be rekindled, to burn again.
notas_originais: Ex. R. s. 2 אש בּוֹעֶרֶת burning fire. Ib. כשם שהסנה בּוֹעֵר וכ' as the bush is burning &c. [Num. R. s. 9, end לבוערים בע"ז, read לבוסרים, v. בָּסַר I, Var. לכיפרים.]
Denom. בַּעַר.
Denom. בְּעִיר.

Pes. 6 a זקוק לבָעֵר is bound to remove (the leaven by burning or otherwise); a. fr.—Shebi. VII, 7 חייב לב' is bound to remove (dispose of the fruits of the Sabbath year in due time). [Num. R. s. 9 (p. 230 b ed. Amst.) מבערים את העון, read with Yalk. Num. 708, Sifré Num. 11 מערערין; oth. vers. מבררין, v. בָּרַר.]
B. Kam. 2 b וּבִעֵר זו השן ‘and it clears’ (Ex. XXII, 4) this refers to injury by the tooth (animal’s eating). [
V. בְּעֵרָה.]

Sabb. 20 a (ref. to לא תבערו וכ' Ex. XXXV, 3) בכל … אי אתה מַבְעִיר ‘in all your dwellings’ thou art not permitted to start a fire; v. הַבְעָרָה. B. Kam. 60 b הַבְּעֵרָה שהִבְעַרְתִּי the fire which I set (to Zion). Ib. 55 b (ref. to Ex. l. c. 5) עד דעביד כעין מבעיר only when he acts like the one setting fire (to clear the field, i.e. criminal negligence); a. e.
Sabb. 37 ab

notas_originais: Targ. O. Ex. III, 2 בָּעַר ed. Berl. (oth. ed. בָּעֵר, Part). Targ. Is. LXII, 1. Targ. Ps. XVIII, 9; a. fr.
Pes. 5 b בְּעִירוּ חמירא וכ' dispose ye of the leavened bread of the (gentile) soldiers (deposited with you).

notas_originais: Targ. II Eth. I, 2 בוערין (some edit. געיין).

notas_originais: B. Kam. VI, 4 השולח את הב' ביד וכ' he who sends out a deaf and dumb, an idiot or a minor with burning materials (live coal &c.) thus causing or ordering a conflagration. Ib. השולח את הב' he who starts a fire (himself). Ib. 60 b, v. בָּעַר.

notas_originais: Targ. Y. II Deut. XV, 10 (ed. Vien. באש). Ib. XXVIII, 54 תַּבְעַשׁ (read תִּבְעַשׁ); 56.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ; interc.; ficar assustado, assustado, confuso.; assustar, confundir.; estar agitado, animado.
notas_originais: with בָּהַת q. v.) to startle. [Not used in Kal.]
Num. R. s. 18; Tanḥ. Korah 6 נזדעזע אהרן ונ' Aaron trembled and was alarmed. Y. Shek. I, beg. Bab. ed. נִבָּעֵית, v. בָּהַת.

Yoma V, 1 (52 b) שלא להַבְעִית וכ' in order not to alarm the people (by a long delay). Ib. 39 b למה אתה מבעית עצמך why wilt thou be the alarmer thyself (predicting thine own destruction; Ms. M. a. Yalk. Zech. 578 את עצמך, incorr.; Ms. Oxf. בעצמך; Y. ib. VI, 43 c bot. מבהלינו, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).
Y. Sabb. VI, 8 b top שהוא מִתְבָּעֵת for he is excited.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. precedido.) ficar excitado.; assustar.; ter medo; estar agitado, ansioso, com pressa (cmp. B. h. חָרַד).
definicoes_originais: to be afraid; to be agitated, anxious, in haste (cmp. b. h. חָרַד).
notas_originais: Nidd. 66 b משום דבעיתא because she is excited (afraid of falling down).

Targ. Ps. XVIII, 5 (Ms. בְּעֵיתַת Pe.).—Keth. 77 b דילמא מְבַעֲתַת לי lest thou frighten me. Ḥull. 53 a sq. בַּעוּתֵי קא מְבַעֲתֵי אהדדי they frighten each other. Nidd. 66 a זיל בַּעֲתָהּ go and frighten her (by a sudden noise).

Targ. I Sam. XXI, 2. Targ. Is. XXII, 4. Targ. II Kings VII, 15 באִתְבְּעָתוּתְהוֹן Regia (ed. באתבעותהון); v. בְּעַע a. בְּעֵי I. Y. Ab. Zar. V, 44 d bot. והוא מתבעת and he is afraid (to touch the wine).—Meg. 3 a האי מאן דמִיבְּעִית when one is suddenly seized with fright. Ib. איבעיתו. Keth. 106 a הוה מיבעית ליה בעותי he ran anxiously to meet him; cmp. Targ. I Sam. l. c.; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (precedido.) terror.
notas_originais: — Pl. בַּעֲתַיָּא. Targ. Ps. LXXXVIII, 17, v. בִּיעוּתָא.

, contr. אִיבְּצֵי to be searched, found out.

Ib. 3. Ib. XXVIII, 12 מִבְּצֵי.

notas_originais: Targ. Job VIII, 11 (Var. כיסנא). Targ. Ps. LXIX, 3 בוצא דמצולתא Ms. (ed. מיא).— Pl. בִּצִּין, בִּצַּיָּא, בִּי'. Targ. Is. XIV, 23. Targ. Y. II Ex. VIII, 1 (ed. Vien. בֵּיצַיָּא). Targ. Ezek. XLVII, 11.

verbetes.glosa_atual: cânhamo, v.
(Pilp. de בוץ ou בצץ; v. בְּצָא) romper, borbulhar, explodir.
definicoes_originais: (Pilp. of בוץ or בצץ; v. בְּצָא) to break through, bubble forth, burst forth.
notas_originais: Sot. 11 b; Ex. R. s. 1 היו מְבַצְבְּצִין וכ' they burst forth and came out of the ground. Keth. 111 b the righteous (dead) שמבצבצין וכ' will break through (the ground) and rise in Jerusalem.—Pes. 13 a היה חמץ מב' the leavened bread crumbled through the bag. Num. R. s. 18, end; Gitt. 56 b דם מב' ויוצא blood bubbled forth. Ḥull. 56 a אם מב' if the brains bubble through the hole in the scull.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Casco. 46 b אי מבצבצא se os pulmões (ao serem colocados na água, ou quando a água é colocada no local doente) lançarem bolhas quando explodidos.
notas_originais: Ḥull. 46 b אי מבצבצא if the lungs (on being put in water, or water being put on the diseased spot) cast bubbles when blown up.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (reduplica. de בצר; cmp. חצוצרה) um compartimento cercado por barras, balaustrada, varanda.
definicoes_originais: (reduplic. of בצר; cmp. חצוצרה) a compartment surrounded with bars, balustrade, balcony.
notas_originais: Midd. II, 5 והקיפוה ב' וכ' and they surrounded the cell (לשכה) with a balcony so that the women could sit above, while the men were seated beneath it; [Succ. 51 b גזוזטרא, Ms. M. גזוזטראות; Tosef. ib. IV, 1 שלש גז']. [The variations כצוצרא, כצוצטרא &c., v. Rabb. D. S. to Sabb. 96 a, Erub. 78 b notes, a. Ar. s. v. גזוזטרא, are clerical errors induced by assonance with the synonymous גזוזטרא. Ἔξώστρα as balcony, for h. עליה, Symm. II Kings I, 2, is itself an adaptation of גזוזטרא.]

V, 8 רעב של ב' וכ' a famine in consequence of high prices, when some are hungry, others are satisfied, רעב של מהומה ושל ב' a famine through political disturbances and through dearth. Gen. R. s. 33 שנת ב' a year of dearth. Taan. III, 1 מכת ב', expl. ib. 19 b מכה המביאה לידי ב' a calamity which will produce dearth (want of rain in season).

notas_originais: Lam. R. introd.; Koh. R. to XII, 7 (interpret. אם הדרך Ezek. XXI, 26) (אם) אמה דבצלית an arm which branches off (direction post on the cross-road).
Erub. 29 b top אי' זירתא (ed. Pesaro a. Ar. אפציל, Var. אבציל) the bulb has grown to the length of a span.

verbetes.glosa_atual: v. precedido.) cebola.
notas_originais: Nidd. 17 a; a. fr.—Maasr. V, 7 (8) ב' של רכפה, expl. in Y. ib. 52 a ‘the stalk of which is pressed inward’; oth. opin. ‘which has no acerbity’, v. אֶרֶס.— Pl. בְּצָלִים. Shebi. II, 9 הב' הסריסים which produce no seeds. Ib. V, 4 ב' הקיצונים summer onions; a. fr.—Ukts. II, 8 עלי ב' ובני ב' the leek-like sprouts, and the central sprouts of onions. Gen. R. s. 82 (ref. to Obad. 6) קליפת ב' (not בצליא) like peeling onions (laying bare Esau’s shame).

verbetes.glosa_atual: cortar, quebrar, esp. partir o pão e dizer a bênção.; dividir a diferença, ajustar, comprometer.; para ajustar.
definicoes_originais: to cut, break, esp. to break bread and say the blessing.
to split the difference, to adjust, compromise.
notas_originais: Ḥull. 7 b מימיו לא ב' על וכ' never said grace over a piece of bread which was not his own (never accepted an invitation). Ber. 46 a בע"הב בּוֹצֵעַ וכ' the host breaks the bread and the guest says grace after meal. Ib. 47 a אין הבוצע רשאי לִבְצוֹעַ וכ' he who is chosen to break the bread, must not begin to break until the Amen of those that respond (to the blessing) is finished; a. fr.

Snh. 6 b top נגמר … לבצוע after the legal proceedings are closed, thou must not act as an arbiter in a compromise. Ib. אסור לב' the court is forbidden to attempt a settlement (you must let the law take its course). Ib. מצוה לב' it is a meritorious act to bring about a settlement. Ib. (before having formed an opinion the judge may say) צאו ובִצְעוּ go out and settle; a. fr.
Y. Snh. I, 18 b top המְבַצֵּעַ חוטא the judge who settles a case is a sinner. Ib. לְבַצֵּעַ (interch. with לבצוע). V. בִּיצּוּעַ.

verbetes.glosa_atual: quebrar.; arrancar, resgatar (cmp. פצי).; quebrar.
notas_originais: B. Bath. 91 b כד הוה ב' ינוקא וכ' when a child broke apart a piece of St. John’s bread. Sabb. 140 b, v. בִּיצּוּעָא.—
Targ. Job XXXIII, 18 יבצע Ms. (ed. ימנע).
Targ. O. Lev. II, 6 (Var. בְּצַע Pe.). [Y. Taan. IV, 69 b; Y. Meg. I, 70 a bot. מבצע (Cant. R. to I, 16 מצנעה) read: מנצב, מנצבה, v. נְצַב.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (בצע, cmp. בִּצָּה) vala, dique, lagoa.
notas_originais: — Pl. בִּצְעִים, בִּצְעִין, בִּי'. Tosef. Snh. III, 4 שתי בצעין ed. Zuck. (Var. ביצועין); Shebu. 16 a שני בצעים וכ' Ar. (read שתי, ed. ביצעין, Ms. M. בצעי') there were two ponds (reservoirs) in Jerusalem, the upper &c. Sabb. 31 a בין בִּצְעֵי המים between the dykes (of the Nile). Snh. 96 a בִּיצְעֵי וכ'. Ib. 5 b, v. בִּצָּה.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. בצבץ) romper, dividir; escorrer, escorrer, pingar.
definicoes_originais: (v. בצבץ) to break through, divide; to ooze, trickle, drip.
notas_originais: Y. Pes. VII, beg. 34 a כל העצים בּוֹצְצִין משקין all other sorts of wood (used for roasting spits) will drip moisture. Y. M. Kat. I, beg. 80 a; Tosef. Mikv. I, 13 ההרים בוצצין (ed. Zuck. ביצין) the mountains are trickling (sending the rain water into the rivers; cmp. preced.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: massa.
notas_originais: Pes. III, 2 (46 a) ב' הַחֵרֵשׁ deaf dough, i.e. having no indications of rising (which makes it doubtful whether or not fermentation has set in); [oth. reading ב' הַחֶרֶשׂ hard and smooth as a potsherd]. Ib. 4; a. fr.— Pl. בְּצֵקוֹת. Ib. 40 a

verbetes.glosa_atual: cortar uvas.; para ser cortado.; ser cortado, diminuído.; cortar, de onde (cmp. גדר)
definicoes_originais: to be railed around, be set apart.
notas_originais: Pes. 3 b בּוֹצְרִין בטהרה one must cut grapes under the rules of levitical cleanness. Gitt. 57 a בָּצְרוּ … את כרמיהן וכ' the gentiles held vintage in vineyards soaked with Israel’s blood; a. fr.
Ex. R. s. 30, beg. עד שתגיע עונתן לִיבָּצֵר until their (the nations’) time has arrived to be cut (ripe for punishment).
Tanḥ. Noah 18 נִבְצָרִים מן וכ' cut off from the world (destroyed). Gen. R. s. 38 יִבָּצֵר מהם shall be denied them.

Part. pass. מְבוּצָּר. Y. Pes. VII, 35 b bot.; Y. Shebu. VIII, beg., 38 b גג מב' a roof surrounded with railings, v. בְּצוֹצְרָה.—Neg. I, 5 מְבוּצֶּרֶת an eruption surrounded with sound flesh; ib. X, 2 sq. מבוצר (of the hair in the flesh affected by the eruption). Deut. R. s. 1 (ref. to עיר מצור Ps. LX, 11, a. מבצר ib. CVIII, 11) עיר שמבוצרת וכ' the city (of Rome) which is well fortified &c.
Ib. שמצירה ומבצרה לישראל (Mat. K. ומְבַצֶּרֶת, Yalk. Ps. 779 מבצרא ch.) the city which troubles and diminishes Israel.
Meg. 14 a; Snh. 110 a; Num. R. s. 18 מקום נ' להם וכ' a place was set apart for them in Gehenna; Koh. R. to VII, 2.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. precedido. a. próximo w.) a ser diminuído.
definicoes_originais: (v. preced. a. next w.) to be diminished.
notas_originais: Keth. 7 b דבָצְרָה מיום אחד who has less than one day’s (celebration of marriage with benedictions at meals).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (neutro v.) ser cortado, diminuído; ser pequeno; querer.; (ato. v.) diminuir, diminuir.; cortar; diminuir, deduzir.
definicoes_originais: (neut. v.) to be cut, lessened; to be small; to want.
to cut off; to diminish, deduct.
notas_originais: Ab. Zar. 9 a כמה בצרן (Rashi בצירן) how much is wanting yet? Targ. Prov. XIV, 28 בציר עמא the population is diminishing.—Ḥull. 42 b בצר להו חדא there is, according to him, one less (than the number stated); a. fr.
Targ. Y. Deut. XIII, 1; IV, 2 (Var. תבַצְּרוּן Pa.). Targ. Job XV, 4.—Nidd. 65 a למִבְצַר לה חדא to allow her one night less; a. fr.

Men. 37 b האי מאן דבַצְּרֵיה לגלימיה he who cuts one corner of his cloak off.—Targ. Koh. III, 5. Targ. Deut. IV, 2, a. e., v. supra.—Ab. Zar. 9 b ונְבַצַּר וכ' we let him deduct therefrom forty eight. B. Mets. 103 b בַּצְּרִי לך I let thee have it for less.—Denom. בַּצִּירָא one who uses the vowel letters sparingly. Ab. Zar. 9 ab and as a mnemonical sign (for remembering when to add and when to deduct) ספרא ב' וכ' the writer of Bible copies writes many words without the vowel letters (defective) which the Mishnah teacher writes plene

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.); = בָּצִיר colheita, trnsf. meios de sustento, comércio (familiar).; por favor. Forte בְּצָרִים.
definicoes_originais: = בָּצִיר crop, trnsf. means of support, ( family-) trade.
notas_originais: Ex. R. s. 40, end לעולם … מניח בִּצְרוֹ one should never give up his trade; Pesik. R. s. 6, end מחליף בְּצִירוֹ (Arakh. 16 אומנותו ואומנות אבותיו). Ex. R. l. c. (insert Job XXII, 24—25 as text) the Lord says, אני הוא בִצְרְכֶן … בִצְרָן וכ' I am your support, give ye never up your support (faith); but also the support of your fathers ye must not give up (labor) &c. Pesik. R. l. c. thou art our God ובְצִירֵנוּ and our support (ref. to Ps. XCV, 6).
Ex. R. l. c. (ref. to Job l. c.; cmp. Targ.) שנעשה חומותיך He will be thy fortification. [Yalk. Deut. 811, v. בִּיצּוּר.]

notas_originais: Y. Dem. II, 22 d top; Tosef. Shebi. IV, 9 (Var. כצת; Hildesh. p. 34 בצץ).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (בקק entrar, pesquisar, v. P. Sm. 573; cmp. בִּינָא III, בִּינִיתָא a. פִּשְׁפָּשׁ) mosquito.
definicoes_originais: (בקק to enter into, search, v. P. Sm. 573; cmp. בִּינָא III, בִּינִיתָא a. פִּשְׁפָּשׁ) gnat.
notas_originais: Ḥull. 58 b לית ב' בר יומא no gnat lives an entire day. Ib. תלו ליה לב' וכ' they suspended on the gnat’s proboscis sixty &c. Ib. אמראי בקת' לבקא Ar. (ed. אמרא ב' מבקא) the she-gnat quarrelled with the he-gnat, v. מרי.— Pl. בַּקֵּי. Succ. 26 a משום ב' on account of the gnats. Sabb. 77 b, v. כַּשְׁכֵּשׁ.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (√בק, v. precedido .; cmp. בצא, a. בין; v. בקר, בקש &c.) para pesquisar, investigar, examinar, descobrir.
definicoes_originais: (√בק, v. preced.; cmp. בצא, a. בין; v. בקר, בקש &c.) to search, investigate, examine, find out.
notas_originais: Part. בָּקֵי. Targ. Prov. XVII, 3 צרפא בקי Bxt. (ed. נקי). Ib. XXIV, 12 בָּאקֵי Ms. (Bxt. a. oth. בצי; corrupt. באהי; h. text יבין).—B. Mets. 84 b בְּקִי באבוך וכ' (Yalk. Prov. 964 בַּקְרִי) find out what thy father is doing now. Pes. 3 b בקי מאי דיניה Ms. M. (ed. בדוק) find out his ways and manners. Gitt. 69 b ליבקי וכ' let one search for the body of one who died on a Sabbath. Koh. R. to XI, 2 (read:) עד דאינון בקיין תרין חיואן וכ' (strike out אזלון בעיין … ונפקין) while they were searching (for the grave), two serpents of fire &c.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (בקא) especialista, versado, familiar.
notas_originais: Targ. I Chr. XI, 11.—Kidd. 10 b ב' בחדרי תורה well acquainted with the chambers (intricacies) of the Law; Y. Keth. V, 29 d bot. ב' בסתרי וכ'. Snh. VII, 2 שלא היה ב"ד ב' the court was not versed in the law. Yoma 49 a ב' ברפואות an expert in medicine. Yeb. 102 a כלום אתה ב' בר' וכ' art thou acquainted with R. &c.?; Tosef. ib. XII, 11 ב' היה לך בר' וכ' ed. Zuck. (read ב' הי' לך ר' as oth. ed.) was R. … well known to thee? Keth. 6 b; a. fr.— Pl. בְּקִיאִין, בְּקִיאֵי. Targ. I Chr. XII, 32 (Var. בקיעין). Ḥull. 4 a אין ב' וכ' (the Samaritans) are not so well versed in the details of the Law as &c. Gitt. 86 b. Kidd. 30 a אינהו ב' … אנן לא בְקִיאִינָן they (the ancients) were versed in Biblical orthography (in defective and plene), we are not.— Fem. בְּקִיאָה. Ḥag. 5 a. [Targ. Y. II Gen. XLIX, 12 בַּקְיִין בהלכה Ar., ed. כה', incorr., Levita in Tishbi בְּקִיאין; Y. I נקיין מן חלבא!]

verbetes.glosa_atual: ervilhaca, v.
(בקע; cmp. בִּצְעָה) fissura, vala, esp. pequeno lago para lavar roupas.
definicoes_originais: (בקע; cmp. בִּצְעָה) fissure, ditch, esp. small pond for washing clothes.
notas_originais: M. Kat. 8 b נברכת וב', expl. as גיהא ובר גיהא a large pond and a small pond. Tosef. B. Bath. I, 2. Ib. M. Kat. I, 9 זו היא נ' … ב' Nibrekheth a. B’kia are the same; Y. ib. I, 80 d כל שהוא תושב וכ' any permanent cut in the ground is called בקיע ( fissure, a grave, wash-pond &c.). [Another opin. in Ar. ב' = אבן ב' a flat stone whereon washers beat their clothes; Y. l. c. כל שהוא וכ' any stone fixed in the ground is called a b’kia.—Ms. M. a. ed. Ven. נְקִיעַ, v. נֶקַע.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (בקע = בקא) = בָּקִיא.
notas_originais: Snh. 5 b ב' במומי (Ms. M. פקיע) an expert in judging bodily defects. B. Bath. 164 b בקיע some ed. (Ms. M. בקי, F. פקיע).— Pl. בְּקִיעִין, בְּקִיעֵי. Targ. I Chr. XII, 32 Var., v. בָּקִי. Shebu. 42 a דכמה דנפישי בקיעי טפי (some ed. בקיאי, Ms. F. פ') the majority of the experts are supposed to be better versed (than the minority).

definicoes_originais: (בקע) that which is demolished by chopping.
notas_originais: Lev. R. s. 19, v. אָלִיס.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (בקע); clivagem, fenda; aquilo que é fendido, um tronco.; atravessando, passando por cima.
definicoes_originais: cleaving, cleft; that which is cloven, a log.
notas_originais: Pl. בְּקִיעוֹת. Koh. R. to II, 23 בקע לי שתי ב' chop for me two logs; (Gen. R. s. 27 בקעיות, v. בְּקַעַת). Koh. R. to X, 9; Gen. R. s. 55, end בשכר שתי ב' שבקע וכ' as a reward for the two pieces of wood which Abraham chopped (Gen. XXII, 3).
Sabb. 101 a בְּקִיעַת דגים the crossing of fish under the ship.

definicoes_originais: B’kiin, ( K’far) P’kiin, modern Fukin, a place in Southern Palestine between Lydda and Jabneh, residence of R. Joshua.
notas_originais: Y. Ḥag. I, beg. 75 d. Snh. 32 b; a. fr.

notas_originais: Pl. בְּקִיקִין. Targ. Y. Ex. XII, 12; Num. XXXIII, 4.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , v. dividir, cortar; para romper.; atravessar, fazer um atalho, passar.; (cmp. בִּצְבֵּץ) para romper o solo, esp. como uma ficção jurídica para uma impureza levítica cuja causa é subterrânea, mas que afeta as coisas acima e abaixo.
definicoes_originais: to split, chop; to break through.
to cross, make a short cut, pass over.
(cmp. בִּצְבֵּץ) to break through the ground, esp. as a legal fiction for a levitical impurity the cause of which is underground, but which affects the things above and beneath.
to be split, to burst open.
to be split; to burst, break.
notas_originais: B. Mets. 99 a בָּ' בו; (Kidd. 47 b בִּיקַּע) if he chopped wood with it. Gen. R. s. 55, end; Koh. R. to X, 9; II, 23, v. בְּקִיעָה. Ex. R. s. 21 אני בוֹקֵעַ להם וכ' I am going to split the sea for them; a. fr.—Lam. R. to II, 2 בקעו בחיילותיו וכ' broke through the lines of N.’s armies; Y. Taan. IV, 69 b top ברחו לתוך.
Y. Pes. I, 27 b bot. חצר שהרבים בּוֹקְעִין וכ' a court which people use for crossing. Erub. 16 b; Sabb. 101 b (a low wall) שהגדיים וכ' ב' over which the kids pass; v. בִּקְעָה.

Ohol. VI, 6 טומאה בּוֹקַעַת וכ' the impurity breaks through the ground and rises, and breaks through and goes down; a. fr.—Koh. R. III, 16 היה הדם בו' ועולה the blood broke through and rose. Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVIII, 45 ב' את הצור, ב' בצור break through (take root in) the rock; a. fr.

Ib. הסיפין נבקעין וכ' the door sells were burst before them. Ib. נ' הספל מאליו the vessel went to pieces of itself. Gen. R. s. 55, end זכה להִבָּקַע הים וכ' he was rewarded by the sea being divided before the children of Israel. Ḥull. 14 b שמא יִבָּקַע הנוד the wine bottle may burst; a. fr.

Kidd. 47 b, v. supra. Y. Bets. I, 60 a bot.; Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41 c bot. שביקעו (שבקעו) להם וכ' of whose flocks the wolves had torn more than &c. Bets. IV, 3 אין מְבַקְּעִין וכ' one must not split woods (on Holy Days) etc. Sifré Deut. 183 (ref. to Deut. XIX, 5) מן העץ המְבַקֵּעַ from the splitting wood (the handle), opp. העץ המִתְבַּקֵּעַ the split wood (the tree). Tanḥ. Vayetse 9 בַּקְּעִי וכ' chop thou &c.—Part. pass. מְבוּקָּע. Ab. Zar. 65 b מְבוּקָּעוֹת grapes burst open.
Sabb. 67 b המְבַקַּעַת ביצים (Rashi Var. המקבעת, Ms. M. עצים) one who squeezes egg-shells &c. (a superstitious practice; Tosef. ib. VI (VII), 18 הנותנת בצים … בכותל).
Shebi. IV, 5 המַבְקִיעַ בזתים וכ' he who cuts olive-trees down (in the Sabbath year) must not cover the stump with ground.
Y. Kil. III, 28 d top להַבְקִיעַ וכ' to plant four rows across a valley from end to end.
Sifré Deut. 183, v. supra.—Sabb. XVI, 5. Cant. R. to VI, 4.

definicoes_originais: cut, notch, whence valley, plane; a group of fields ; v. בָּאגִא; esp. a short cut for farm-laborers &c. Toh. notas_originais: B. Bath. 61 b when one sells … a field בב' גדולה within a large group of fields (all belonging to the seller). Ib. (in a place) where they call לשדה ש' ולב' ב' a field sadeh and an estate bikah ; a. fr.—Trnsf. an unguarded field, moral danger. Erub. 6 a; 100 b; Ḥull. 110 a רב ב' מצא וכ' Rab found an unguarded field and fenced it in, i.e. found people transgressing the law in ignorance and instituted preventive regulations.— Pl. בְּקָעוֹת. Gen. R. s. 98.—2) (constr.) בִּקְעַת pr. n. pl. Valley of—, as ב' יזרעאל, ב' ידים &c., for all of which see the respective determinants.

definicoes_originais: v. בָּקַר) morning, early day ; metaph.
notas_originais: light, salvation. Y. Taan. I, 64 a top ב' לצדיקים וכ' a morning for the righteous, a night for the wicked. Ruth. R. to III, 13 בַּבּ' בעולם וכ' ‘in the morning’—that means in the world which is all-good. Esth. R., introd. (ref. to Deut. XXVIII, 67) בבָקְרָהּ של בבל וכ' in the morning (ascendancy) of Babel thou shalt say, Oh that her evening (downfall) would come! Gen. R. s. 21 (ref. to Dan. VIII, 14) לִכְשֶׁיֵּעָשֶׂה בָּקְרָן וכ' when the morning of the (persecuting) nations shall become evening, and the evening of Israel morning; Tanḥ. ed. Bub. B’resh. 23. Mekh. Bo, s. 6 in order to define it: לבָקְרוֹ של ב' at the very break of morning; Y. Ber. I, 2 c top.— Pl. בְּקָרִים. Yoma 33 b חלקהו לשני ב' divide the acts prescribed into two mornings, i.e. let another act be inserted between. Ber. 27 a חלקהו לשני ב' take only one half of the morning hours. Y. Pes. V, 31 d top אית לך מימר תמן בין הַבְּקָרַיִם then it ought to have read there ben hab-b’karaim (as you read בין הערבים, Du.).
